title: hedyotis serpyllifolia

It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in China, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
